items.name: standard-lint
items.title: Standard Lint
items.description: @shadcn/lint rules for the Standard library: theme colors only, sizes through props, containers take spacing.
items.docs: Add to eslint.config.mjs: `import { standardLint } from "./lib/standard-lint.mjs"`, then spread `...standardLint()` at the end of the exported array. Pass `standardLint({ ui: "@/your/components" })` if Standard lives somewhere other than @/components/standard. Run `npx eslint .`.
